condition.narrative: Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.

MCA-N and MCC have made a determination to proceed with construction and or/rehabilitation based on satisfactory review by MCC of a completed final feasibility and design study and any requisite environmental assessment work, to include an EMP and, as needed, a RAP.
MCA-N provides evidence of continued compliance, satisfactory to MCC, with the road-specific EMP.

MCA-N provides evidence that any required RAP, including full payment of resettlement costs, has been implemented in accordance with World Bank operational policy on involuntary resettlement and in a manner acceptable to MCC.
MCA-N provides evidence, satisfactory to MCC, that it has completed the acquisition of rights of way for secondary roads to be constructed.
MCA-N submits to MCC a copy of a report on file with MCA-N, acceptable to MCC, verifying that all M&E baseline data has been gathered for each segment of secondary road.
